head: Pixel camera not working after Android 17 November update
dek: Some Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL owners report a black camera screen or a Camera app that won't open after Google's November update, Android 17 QPR2. Google hasn't confirmed the problem or released a fix.
details: One Pixel 11 Pro XL owner saw the message "Something went wrong. Close and open the Camera app again." Other owners report a missing Desktop Mode icon, Alt + Tab not working, a Pixel 9 Pro Fold whose main screen stays dark after unfolding, and a Pixel 10 Pro whose lock screen can't be changed. The update is rolling out in stages. The reports come from Google's community forum and Reddit.
where: Pixel phones on Android 17 QPR2, November 2026; mostly Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL
means: If your Pixel hasn't installed the November update yet and you rely on its camera, you may want to wait for a fix.
todo: If the camera stops working, turn the phone off, wait one to two minutes and turn it back on: a Google forum moderator suggested this, and it brought the camera back for at least one owner.
